question: For each rating category of the first movie rented by customers—where the first movie is identified based on the earliest payment date per customer—please provide the average total amount spent per customer and the average number of subsequent rentals (calculated as the total number of rentals minus one) for customers whose first rented movie falls into that rating category.
sql:
WITH customer_first_rental AS (
    SELECT 
        p.customer_id,
        f.rating
    FROM payment p
    INNER JOIN rental r ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id
    INNER JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
    INNER JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id
    WHERE p.payment_date = (
        SELECT MIN(p2.payment_date)
        FROM payment p2
        WHERE p2.customer_id = p.customer_id
    )
),
customer_totals AS (
    SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) as customer_total_amount FROM payment GROUP BY customer_id
),
customer_rentals AS (
    SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) as customer_total_rentals FROM rental GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT 
    fcr.rating,
    AVG(ct.customer_total_amount) as average_total_amount,
    AVG(crd.customer_total_rentals - 1) as average_subsequent_rentals
FROM customer_first_rental fcr
INNER JOIN customer_totals ct ON fcr.customer_id = ct.customer_id
INNER JOIN customer_rentals crd ON fcr.customer_id = crd.customer_id
GROUP BY fcr.rating
ORDER BY fcr.rating
